event_properties.content: Show me complaints from last Sunday
Last Sunday had **6 complaints**: 3 about 45+ min wait for dine-in, 2 about wrong orders on Swiggy, 1 about billing error. All 6 came in between 1pm–3pm — your peak lunch rush window.
Which items are mentioned most in negative reviews?

**Chicken Biryani** leads negative mentions (12 times) — customers say the portion has gotten smaller. **Paneer Tikka** is second (8 times) — mostly about being undercooked. **Cold coffee** gets 5 mentions for being too sweet.
